title: Open RMS AGV fault drop-down to view current faults/errors
summary: Use the small drop-down in the RMS / fleet status UI map monitor summary area to reveal current AGV fault/error items that need attention when the drop-down is hidden or collapsed.
when_to_use: When you need to view the current AGV faults/errors list from the RMS map monitor summary area and the drop-down is hidden/collapsed.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and expand the AGV faults drop-down to identify which fault/error items are currently present.

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Message Panel area showing the small drop-down to show AGV faults (and related summary metrics).
Map Monitor Message Panel area showing the small drop-down to show AGV faults (and related summary metrics).

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI map monitor summary area
steps.purpose: Get to the RMS map monitor summary area where the AGV faults drop-down is located.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) and navigate to the map monitor summary area that contains the Map Monitor Message Panel metrics and the small drop-down for AGV faults.
steps.expected_result: The RMS map monitor summary area is visible, including the small drop-down control associated with showing AGV faults.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Map Monitor Message Panel metrics region that includes the AGV faults drop-down control.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS map monitor summary area is not visible or you cannot locate the AGV faults drop-down control in that region.

actions.label: Locate AGV faults drop-down region
actions.exact_action: Locate the small drop down here (AGV faults drop-down) in the RMS map monitor summary area.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “There's a small drop down… Sometimes this is hidden… if you have a current fault that needs to be addressed, it will show up here… click that drop down menu… see the errors.”

steps.title: Expand the AGV faults drop-down if it is hidden/collapsed
steps.purpose: Reveal the current fault/error list items so they can be read.
steps.instruction: Check whether the AGV faults drop-down is visible. If it is hidden/collapsed, locate the drop-down control in the summary area and click it to expand.
steps.expected_result: The AGV faults drop-down expands and displays the current fault/error items list.
steps.healthy_condition: The drop-down expands from its collapsed/hidden state to show the errors list.
steps.failure_condition: The drop-down does not expand (remains hidden/collapsed) or no fault/error items appear when it is expanded.

actions.label: Click AGV faults drop-down
actions.exact_action: Click that drop down menu to see the errors.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Sometimes this is hidden, but if you have a current fold that needs to be addressed, it will show up here… if it's hidden, you click that drop down menu and you will be able to see the errors.”

steps.title: Read the current fault/error items from the expanded drop-down
steps.purpose: Identify which current AGV faults/errors are present from the RMS summary area.
steps.instruction: With the AGV faults drop-down expanded, read the list of current fault/error items shown in the drop-down.
steps.expected_result: The expanded drop-down shows a list of current fault/error items that need attention.
steps.healthy_condition: The drop-down contains one or more fault/error list items corresponding to current faults that need addressing.
steps.failure_condition: The drop-down shows no fault/error items even though other RMS indicators suggest active errors/warnings.

actions.label: Read fault/error list
actions.exact_action: Read the errors shown in the expanded drop-down list.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the drop-down does not reveal any faults while other indicators (e.g., message panel) show active errors/warnings.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “...if you have a current fault that needs to be addressed, it will show up here… click that drop down menu… see the errors.”

steps.title: Stop and escalate when the drop-down list is insufficient for deeper investigation
steps.purpose: Avoid proceeding when the drop-down does not provide enough detail to identify affected AGV(s) or fault details.
steps.instruction: If the expanded drop-down shows faults that require deeper investigation and you cannot identify the affected AGV(s) or fault details from the drop-down list, stop and escalate.
steps.expected_result: You escalate rather than guessing when the drop-down list alone cannot identify the affected AGV(s) or provide sufficient fault details.
steps.healthy_condition: Fault/error items are identifiable enough from the drop-down list to determine what needs further investigation.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to proceed without being able to identify affected AGV(s) or fault details from the drop-down list.

actions.label: Escalate for deeper investigation
actions.exact_action: Stop and escalate if the drop-down shows faults that require deeper investigation and you cannot identify the affected AGV(s) or fault details from the drop-down list.

stop_or_escalate_if: Drop-down shows faults requiring deeper investigation and affected AGV(s)/fault details cannot be identified from the drop-down list.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate escalation note: “Stop and escalate if the drop-down shows faults that require deeper investigation and you cannot identify the affected AGV(s) or fault details from the drop-down list.”

success_criteria: The AGV faults drop-down is expanded in the RMS map monitor summary area.
The expanded drop-down displays the current fault/error items list.
healthy_conditions: AGV faults drop-down expands and shows current fault/error items.
Fault/error items are readable from the expanded drop-down list.
failure_conditions: AGV faults drop-down remains hidden/collapsed and cannot be expanded.
Expanded drop-down shows no fault/error items while other RMS indicators show active errors/warnings.
Fault/error items require deeper investigation but affected AGV(s) or fault details cannot be identified from the drop-down list.
escalation_guidance: Escalate when the drop-down list does not provide enough information to identify affected AGV(s) or fault details, or when the drop-down shows no faults despite other RMS indicators showing active errors/warnings.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: “There's a small drop down… Sometimes this is hidden… if you have a current fault that needs to be addressed, it will show up here… click that drop down menu… see the errors.”

missing_details: The source does not provide exact UI label text for the AGV faults drop-down control or the exact fault/error list item formatting; image support is requested to capture the control and list items.
